description: Controlled retrieval-scale experiment using deterministic canonical Source and claim import, then actual local embeddings and index rebuild. These pre-authored claims are not evidence of live extraction quality or cost.

method.ingest: Retain Source bytes in fresh temporary Loupist; bind each prepared claim to actual retained span IDs and seal through Rust canonical service, without a paid extraction.
method.derived_index: Rebuild from that confirmed SQLite snapshot using production local embeddings and query_indexed. Never write to the real user graph.
method.focal_order: Use the supplied stable claim IDs and insertion order, with focal last. Capture actual browse page membership; if it is not outside the first20 at20/100 noise, beyond-first-page measurement is unmeasured, not assumed.
method.questions: Identical queries and final question across sizes and baseline/candidate. No oracle values injected into Chat beyond retained Source/World evidence.
method.live_extraction_cost: Not measured by this fixture. Use only actual lifecycle source-processing telemetry for paid extraction scaling observations.
